txtContent: =if(@currentField == '', '', toLocaleDateString(@currentField) + '  |  ' + if(floor((Number(@currentField) - Number(@now)) / 86400000) < 0, 'Overdue ' + (0 - floor((Number(@currentField) - Number(@now)) / 86400000)) + 'd', 'In ' + floor((Number(@currentField) - Number(@now)) / 86400000) + 'd'))
